title: Klein Bottles - Numberphile
summary: Numberphile interviews Cliff Stoll about Klein bottles, the one-sided surfaces with no inside or outside. Stoll explains them with characteristic enthusiasm and shows off his collection.
why: HN likes it for Cliff Stoll's infectious passion for topology, and it gets linked in threads about him and about Mobius strips.

quote.text: This guys passion for Mobius Strips is infectious.
